name: T3rnel WavePay
description: Checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — one integration reaches Zimbabwean wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch) and international rails (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal). Merchants self-register with one POST.

mcp.authentication: none for wavepay_register; x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_… for merchant tools — mint via POST /v2/register or the register tool
mcp.stdioShim: mcp-server.mjs in the repo forwards stdio MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Devin) to the HTTP endpoint

tools.name: wavepay_register
tools.description: Register a merchant account — returns merchantId and a live mk_live_… key on the free tier. Works unsigned.

tools.name: wavepay_providers
tools.description: List the payment rails this deployment has enabled right now.

tools.name: wavepay_pricing
tools.description: Plans, prices and promotions for a product id.

tools.name: wavepay_catalog
tools.description: Everything the caller's merchant key can sell — sites, plans, live prices.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout
tools.description: Create a hosted checkout and get the buyer URL.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll a checkout's settlement status by reference.
